record.context_brief: moduli of wild G-torsors on the punctured disk
record.original_question: Can one construct the moduli space Delta_G of G-torsors over the punctured formal disk as an inductive limit of finite-type Deligne-Mumford stacks?

evidence.quote: Problem 8.1. Can we construct the moduli space ∆G of G-torsors over the punctured formal disk D ∗ = Spec kLtM as an inductive limit of Deligne-Mumford stacks of finite type?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $k$ be an algebraically closed field of positive characteristic, let $D^{*} = \operatorname{Spec} k(\!(t)\!)$ be the punctured formal disk, and let $G$ be a (possibly wild) finite group, regarded as a constant group scheme over $k$. Consider the moduli problem $\Delta_{G}$ that to a $k$-algebra $R$ associates the groupoid of $G$-torsors over $\operatorname{Spec} R(\!(t)\!)$ (equivalently, étale $G$-covers of the punctured formal disk over $R$).

Construct $\Delta_{G}$ as an inductive (filtered) limit
$$\Delta_{G} \;=\; \varinjlim_{i \in I} \mathcal{X}_{i}$$
of Deligne–Mumford stacks $\mathcal{X}_{i}$ of finite type over $k$, with transition morphisms $\mathcal{X}_{i} \to \mathcal{X}_{j}$ that exhibit $\Delta_{G}$ as a reasonable geometric object (for example with separated, finite, and universally injective transition maps), or prove that no such presentation exists.
artifact.status_search_result: Work of Tonini and Tonini–Yasuda ("Moduli of formal torsors" and "Moduli of formal torsors II") constructs the moduli stack of G-torsors over the formal punctured disk for finite G and shows it is a limit of separated Deligne–Mumford stacks with finite, universally injective transition maps, in particular for groups that are semidirect products of a p-group and a tame cyclic group. A construction strictly as an inductive limit of finite-type DM stacks for general wild G in the strongest sense remains not fully settled, so the problem is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Moduli of formal torsors
status_evidence.snippet: Construction of moduli space of torsors over the formal punctured disk as a limit of Deligne–Mumford stacks.
status_evidence.claim: A version of the moduli of G-torsors over the punctured formal disk is constructed as a limit of separated DM stacks with finite, universally injective transition maps.

status_evidence.title: Moduli of formal torsors II
status_evidence.snippet: Further development of the moduli of G-torsors over the punctured formal disk for finite groups including wild cases.
status_evidence.claim: Provides further construction and properties for the moduli of formal torsors, partially answering the question.
